rationale: Figure 1 is the only contact-sheet panel that visibly shows the actual Bio-BLIP input route and interface: AlphaGenome/GenePT/ESM embeddings enter modality-specific Q-formers, are fused by the Master Q-former, become a fixed-length multimodal prefix, and are passed to a frozen LLM. That directly supports the pretraining routes and the Stage 1 connector routes, not just evaluation results.
